quote=sikirsk;59793678][b]Operation Centinal I[/b]

[i]The [b]Grand Federation[/b] today mounts upon one if its first open combat situations since its civil war, we have expanded and readied the Nestor-Sikirsk Army and we shall strike them down.
[/i]
These Cultists shall not be allowed to live upon the rightful cultural land of Greater [nation]Nestor-Sikirsk[/nation]ian protected territory.

Bombing Raids have started, focusing upon important infrastructure of [nation]Enkia[/nation]. All while the 4th Mechanized Army has surrounded the main government buildings of this nation, reaching them within minutes because of the small size, aswell as the pretty much flat territory which the nation consists of.

[b]---[/b]

[i]Picture of Sikirskian Tank below, near the city of Bouldvrski, Nestor Sikirsk: https://ibb.co/d48d8yBH[/i][/quote]

When it became clear what was happening,  the high priest Malchadorus had set about delivering what would not be, he hoped, his final address. 
"My Fellow Enkians, our people have been dealt a most devastating blow.
The people of [nation]Nestor-Sikirsk[/nation] have declared war upon us and have been joined by the people [nation]Orphogron[/nation], [nation]Western View[/nation], and [nation]Italian dutch[/nation]. Make no mistake,  they are here to invade our sovereign land, kill not just us but our culture and way of life. As Satan said in the Al Jilwah; "those that take life without just cause shall have their lives justly taken."
People of Enkia you must take up arms against the Sikirskian invaders. Fight tooth and nail, because all of our lives now rest in the hands of the Patriots who fought against the invaders.  Please report to any clear military bases, for ammo, a rifle, and if there's time training. The Invaders may indeed have taken our lands, and they may have indeed pushed far into our lands. But we know Enkia better than them, we know every hole, ditch, shrub, and bush across this land and though these people have come to take our land away from us, we will not relinquish it kindly! For every inch of Enkian Soil they take, we must throw ourselves at them, so that every inch costs 10,000 men! Every building they take will only be done so, when the building has been reduced to rubble. They will regret setting foot on our lands when they find a gun, armed and loaded, behind every blade of grass!!" A man in a suit holding an automatic rifle comes into frame whispering something in Malchadorus's ear. The Priest pulls a pistol from his robe and racks back the slide.
"Martial Law has been declared. Fight for your lives, fight for your freedom, Fight for Satan! Ave Satanas, my friends, my family. May we Earn our places in Hell this day."
The agent and the priest exit the frame, and the citizens could hear shouts, and gunshots before the screen cuts out to a signal lost screen.

Over the coming week, as the Sikirskian Invasion of Enkia, the people had organized quickly, and by the time the Sikirskians made their way into the western region, they found a heavily armed, and fiercely combative people. Roads were booby trapped with IEDs, the Enkians had developed and ambush tactic of placing an IED to stop a convoy, before allowing the enemy to exit. From there Enkians had somehow managed to time their shots so well, that when the Enkians fired on the now exposed soldiers in unison, keeping their numbers and positions hidden.
The first week of invasion became known as All Hallow's Week, so named for the Enkian Freedom Fighters who would take to wearing halloween masks to hide their identity.
